observations: The core T037 obligations are independently reproduced: both the repository-wide and the strict C++-scoped routes are warning-free (exit 0, 0 warnings), the strict scope indexes all 33 owned files with 0 file-block coverage gaps, and every owned-source diff is Doxygen-comment-only.

Evidence-summary accuracy note (non-blocking): reports/review-index.md:1097 states '27 of the 35 owned' src/xverse/xcom C++ files. The owned set is exactly 33 .hpp/.cpp files and the strict route indexes 33, so the sentence should read '27 of the 33 owned'. The work products proper (implementation.md:55) say only 'the 27 edited C++ files' and are unaffected.

Evidence-summary accuracy note (non-blocking): docs/engineering/xcom/t037/implementation.md:84, :170, :199 and reports/review-index.md:1116 state '57 stale implemented_by digest pins were refreshed'. The number of pins whose recorded target digest actually changed between baseline and candidate is 48 (11 project.json + 37 other edited artifacts); 57 equals the candidate implemented_by links targeting the edited artifacts other than engineering/project.json (48 existing + 20 new T037 links). The substance is correct: all 48 changed pins equal the current SHA-256 values and validate_trace reports no stale pin. Recommend the deferred external review reconcile the prose count.

Evidence-summary accuracy note (non-blocking): docs/engineering/xcom/t037/verification-plan.md:77 and detailed-design.md:46 list B-3 'python3 scripts/check_doxygen.py --self-test --coverage-only' with expected 'exit 0'. The command exits 1 both at the accepted baseline and at the candidate because the preserved coverage check fails on inherited Python docstrings (T037-OPEN-06); the self-test function itself does detect the synthetic module/function and header. implementation.md:120 deliberately omits an exit-code claim for B-3 and discloses the inherited failure, so no false pass is recorded, but the plan expectation is not reconciled.

The implementation record is intentionally excluded from the report material inventory so it can cite the report hash/digest without a circular binding (T036 precedent); the report hashes map therefore omits docs/engineering/xcom/t037/implementation.md.

The repository-wide route keeps WARN_IF_UNDOCUMENTED=NO/WARN_NO_PARAMDOC=NO because its admitted inputs include out-of-scope Python and test sources; declaration-level strictness is exercised only by the C++-scoped configuration and is disclosed as T037-GAP-02.

T035's conformance failure (E-T035-2) is an inherited accepted-baseline inconsistency owned by T038/T040 or the Phase 6 conformance-pin maintainer, not a T037 candidate defect; T037 introduces no trace endpoint or pin that would worsen it.
limitations: Read-only review of the working-tree candidate at HEAD == baseline; the review record is the only artifact written by this stage and it edits no production code, test, or evidence artifact.
The strict declaration-level coverage is scoped to the owned src/xverse/xcom C++ inputs; the repository-wide route is not declaration-level strict for out-of-scope Python/test inputs.
The inherited Python docstring findings in scripts/** and src/xverse_xdl/** remain and are reported as a limitation, not as passing.
The review does not establish external Codex review, user acceptance, or platform-main delivery; those remain deferred until the ordered backlog completes (T038-T041).
method: Read-only inspection of the exact 76-path candidate union; independent comment-stripping equivalence of the 27 changed C++ files; independent re-execution of the repository-wide and strict C++ Doxygen routes; independent recomputation of the report material digest and all 80 per-file hashes; Doxyfile alias diff review; checker mode and self-test exercise; fabro_engineering.core.validate_trace endpoint resolution; baseline-vs-candidate links.json pin diff; REF-002 register inspection; ctest inventory comparison for every named T037 case; T035/T036 evidence inspection; and public-safety/forbidden-resource scanning.
